pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Heterogeneous dark brown polygonal regions exhibiting predominantly smooth to moderately angular edge gradients. Patch geometry transitions from larger, elongated rectangles on the upper neck to smaller, more irregularly shaped quadrilaterals on the shoulder and flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous off-white interstitial pathways forming a complex topological mesh. Junction nodes are clearly defined as tri- and quadri-point intersections. Corridor thickness is relatively uniform on the neck, becoming narrower and more dense in the lower flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous, high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck. The mane is composed of short, vertical follicles creating a uniform jagged 1D geometric contour.
